_comment: Mandatory RADAR floors — anchor tests the selector may never drop, whatever the blast-radius analysis says. Each maps to a system-level invariant Enforcer has committed to protect.

floors.invariant: no silent corruption of persisted state
floors.reason: the enrichment endpoint must append, never mutate the original audit event

floors.invariant: no silent corruption of persisted state
floors.reason: audit store is append-only; count only increases

floors.invariant: no authorization bypass on any privileged operation
floors.reason: policy engine defaults to deny on unmatched actions

floors.invariant: no authorization bypass on any privileged operation
floors.reason: MCP gateway denies calls to unregistered servers and non-allowlisted tools

floors.invariant: no privilege escalation without a recorded human decision
floors.reason: break-glass requires a rationale; approval scopes are single-use / time-bounded

floors.invariant: no authorization bypass on any privileged operation
floors.reason: RBAC role boundaries on the daemon and hub APIs
